name: Saigon Corner
notes: 5 of 5 photos were menus: photo 1 is a full digital menu board (noodle soups/dry noodle/rice plates/rice porridge); photos 2 and 4 are near-duplicate shots of a two-sided printed card (pho, udon, DIY wrap, kid's menu, drink menu); photo 3 is a closer crop of the card's rice-plate and appetizer columns adding several items; photo 5 is a clearer close-up of the drink menu with a few newer prices/items than photos 2/4, used as the drink source. Where the digital board and printed card gave two prices for the same dish (Cơm Tấm Sườn-Bì-Chả), the digital board's price was kept. Add-on modifiers (extra fish, softshell crab) were dropped per rules.
